full_judgment:
Let a Rule Nisi be issued calling upon the respondent to show cause as to why they should net be directed to hand over the possession of the property measuring an area of 2.8172 acres of land appertaining to C.S. Plot No.186 under C.S. Khatian No.6615 of C.S. Sheet No.22 and Touzi No.13448 of Mouza Shahar Dhaka at present Ramna, Ward No.3, within Police Station Kotwali, subsequently under Police Station Ramna, and now within Shahbag Police Station, District Dhaka, in favour of the petitioner and/or pass such other or further order or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper. The Rule is made returnable within 4(four) weeks from date. 

 We also direct the Inspector General of Police to take immediately possession and to protect the land in question and to see that no further change in the nature and character of the land in question measuring an area of 2.8172 acres appertaining to C.S. Plot No.I86 under C.S. Khatian No.66I5 of C.S. Sheet "No.22 and Towzi No.13448 of Mouza Shahar Dhaka at present Ramna, Ward No.3 of Police Station Kotwali at present Ramna District Dhaka can take place till further order of this Court.
